integrity: Original binary code construction and older closed-cube matrix results are credited; no originality or independent certification of these prior ingredients is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact even-rank parity availability is determined only for ranks 2 and 4; for even ranks at least 6 the upper bound may not be optimal. Linear single-symbol recovery, arbitrary helper sizes; full text of plausible 2011 related source was not accessible.
title: A disjoint-repair availability dichotomy for binary closed-cube systematic codes
